moments.title: Pipe lining, also known as cured-in-place pipe (CIPP), is a trenchless technique for repairing damaged underground or in-wall pipes. It works by inserting a flexible tube saturated with epoxy or similar resin into the ex
moments.selftext: Pipe lining, also known as cured-in-place pipe (CIPP), is a trenchless technique for repairing damaged underground or in-wall pipes. It works by inserting a flexible tube saturated with epoxy or similar resin into the existing pipe, inflating it against the walls, and curing the resin to create a seamless, durable new inner lining, without extensive digging.

moments.title: Behind the scenes of Terminator 2: Judgment Day (1991). Seeing the T-800 grab lunch during a break on the hospital set is a hilarious contrast to the intensity of Terminator 2: Judgment Day. Arnold Schwarzenegger, still
moments.selftext: Behind the scenes of Terminator 2: Judgment Day (1991). Seeing the T-800 grab lunch during a break on the hospital set is a hilarious contrast to the intensity of Terminator 2: Judgment Day. Arnold Schwarzenegger, still dressed in full costume, casually eats from a paper plate alongside Edward Furlong, Linda Hamilton, and Robert Patrick between takes. More than 30 years later, T2 remains one of the greatest action movies ever made, and behind-the-scenes photos like this make its legacy feel even more human. It’s strange to see such iconic characters reduced to a cast sitting around a folding table between setups, reminding us that even the biggest movie moments were created during ordinary downtime.
